gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Reolink Argus Eco Ultra (B360) needs a firmware update before it can join a Reolink Home Hub, while the Argus 4 Pro works with it out of the box. It also says nothing about Reolink's Eco Ultra page saying the camera has no RTSP or NAS support, or about the eufy SoloCam S340 needing camera firmware V3.3.2.6 or later to pair with a HomeBase S380.
standout_why: Compared against the two pages ChatGPT cited. rottenwifi.com (2026-08-09) gives Wi-Fi bands (S340 2.4 GHz only, Argus 4 Pro dual-band), says the Argus 4 Pro works with Home Hub, says the S3 Pro is 'not HomeBase 2' and names the Solar Panel 2 (6 W) for the Argus 4 Pro. It gives no firmware prerequisites, no panel connector types, no wattage for the S340 or C660 panel, and it doesn't cover the C660. reolink.com's buying guide (2026-10-28) lists the Argus Eco Ultra and Argus 4 Pro as Home Hub compatible and says the Home Hub excludes 4G cameras. It doesn't mention the Eco Ultra's firmware-upgrade requirement or the RTSP/NAS difference between the two Argus models. Neither page covers Tapo's H500 hub or the C660 kit's panel model.
decides: It confirms the S340 and C660 picks and sharpens the choice between the two Reolink cameras. If a shopper wants recordings on a NAS or an RTSP feed through a Reolink Home Hub, the Argus 4 Pro ($179.99) is the one whose maker page says it supports both via the hub. The Argus Eco Ultra ($129.99) page says it doesn't, and the Eco Ultra must be updated before it pairs. S340 buyers who add a HomeBase S380 need camera firmware V3.3.2.6 or later. The C660 kit's included panel delivers 2.5 W at most, against the 6 W Solar Panel 2 Reolink recommends for the Argus 4 Pro.

findings.value: 2.2 W adjustable, removable panel (mounts on the camera or nearby by cable); 8 GB built-in eMMC; 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; no 24/7 recording even when connected to HomeBase 3

findings.label: Home Hub firmware prerequisite
findings.value: Hardware BIPC_560MIX16M35B238MP (B360) is 'Released, upgradable': it must be on the latest firmware before it can be added to a Home Hub or Home Hub Pro
findings.note: The same article lists the Argus 4 series as 'No requirements / Factory-supported, no firmware upgrade needed'. 4G cameras are 'Not Supported'. Home Hub limit is 8 cameras; Home Hub Pro is 12, or up to 24 battery cameras depending on hardware.

findings.label: Storage and integration limits stated by maker
findings.value: Cloud or microSD (up to 512 GB) only; no PoE NVR, no NAS, no RTSP/RTMP; USB-C charging port; Solar Panel 2 sold separately; dual-band 2.4/5 GHz
findings.source_title: Reolink Argus Eco Ultra product page
findings.note: Taken from the product page FAQ and spec table. This FAQ may predate Home Hub support, which Reolink's Home Hub article now confirms for B360. The box holds the camera, mounting plate, security bracket, strap and USB-C cable, with no panel.

findings.label: Home Hub, NAS and RTSP
findings.value: Home Hub compatible; NAS storage and RTSP supported through a Reolink Home Hub; USB-C port; Reolink recommends Solar Panel 2 (6 W), which is not in the box
findings.source_title: Reolink Argus 4 Pro + SP product page
findings.note: From the spec sheet ('Home Hub Compatibility: YES') and the FAQ. Recording is triggered only, microSD up to 512 GB, operating range -10 to 55 °C.

findings.label: Solar panel compatibility rule and exclusions
findings.value: All Reolink rechargeable battery cameras work with Reolink solar panels if the charging ports match, except Reolink Argus (original), KEEN and Doorbell (Battery). PoE and DC-powered cameras are not compatible. If the ports differ, use a USB-to-Type-C cable.
findings.source_title: Which Cameras Can Work with Reolink Solar Panel (Reolink Support)
findings.note: The per-model panel table did not extract cleanly, so I left out which panel goes with which model.

findings.label: NVR limits for battery cameras
findings.value: Battery-powered 4G cameras do not support NVRs. Once a battery Wi-Fi camera is added to an NVR it can no longer be used standalone in the app without a hard reset.
findings.source_title: Can I Add Reolink Battery-powered Cameras to Reolink NVR (Reolink Support)
findings.note: The page says support depends on the camera and NVR model and version. The model table did not render.

findings.label: Included panel and pairing specs
findings.value: Includes a Tapo A201 solar panel with bracket, a USB adapter cable and an extension wire. Panel output is USB Type-C with max charging power 2.5 W at 5.2 V. Wi-Fi is 2.4/5 GHz, microSD up to 512 GB, works with Google Assistant and Alexa. Charging temperature is 32–113 °F.
findings.note: The specs page names no hub. The product page names the Tapo H500 (sold separately) as the hub for HDD/SSD storage.
